source.title: Pantry Intake Form: Household Application for USDA Foods

questions.label: Name of Proxy (if applicable)
questions.note: Someone else who may pick up food; not in the profile.

questions.label: Address of Proxy
questions.note: The proxy's address, not the applicant's.

questions.label: Address of Proxy: City
questions.note: The proxy's city, not the applicant's.

questions.label: Address of Proxy: Zip
questions.note: The proxy's ZIP, not the applicant's.

questions.label: If the household receives other assistance, mark the appropriate choice(s) below and skip the “Total Household Income” and crisis situation sections.
options: National School Lunch Program (NSLP) (free or reduced-price meals)
questions.note: Programs the household already receives; the profile only knows what the applicant is applying for.

questions.label: Total Household Income
questions.note: The applicant writes the period ("per ___") beside the amount, so no single saved amount fits the blank.

questions.label: ANSWER ONLY if your household does not receive the government assistance listed above AND your income does not fall within the USDA income guidelines above: Was there a crisis situation that caused you to need food?
If yes, please state the situation
